# Rework round 4 claims (personal_loan_servicing)

PLS-R3-1: closed — every write policy's rule now says what happens when its amount works out to 0.00 (or below). The behaviour matches the task tools (each records only the amount it is given and is simply not called when nothing is written), and every prerequisite sentence and condition that waits on that write's record now has the same scope.
PLS-R3-1(i) late fee: closed — a late fee that works out to 0.00 is not charged. No late-fee line is written, and it does not count as a late fee charged on the loan. The pay-cycle tier-2 ladder text says the same. The courtesy waiver's late-fee prerequisite sentence (rule, policy_source and the task-1 copies) now waits only for a late fee that works out above 0.00. Its condition says a 0.00 late fee writes no line and then nothing is waited on, so no world deadlocks.
PLS-R3-1(ii) courtesy waiver: closed — a courtesy waiver that works out to 0.00 is not granted. No waiver line is written, so it uses none of the grade's courtesy waivers and is not the fee's one waiver. The waiver-form tier-1 ladder text says the same. With no late fee on the loan there is nothing to waive, and compute now returns zero for that case instead of failing. The task-1 skip-effect text now says the 0.00 waiver is not granted.
PLS-R3-1 class, returned fee: closed — the general zero sentence now covers every form, schedule_c included. A 0.00 fee writes no line and does not count toward the monthly returned-fee limit. The courtesy prerequisite sentence and condition now wait only for a fee that works out above 0.00.
PLS-R3-1 class, payoff quote, refinance application and AutoPay enrollment: closed — each rule now states its zero case. A payoff quote is issued only on a loan with unpaid principal, so it is always above 0.00 and always recorded. The amount financed is never below the payoff to be covered, and a loan with no unpaid principal is never quoted or sized. The enrollment is recorded in every case, and its rate is always above 0.00 because no rate base is as low as the full AutoPay discount. A scratch probe of each confirmed it.
R3-O1: carried — schedule_b tier 2 stays a relief measure. Its 0.00 outcome is now an explicit no-charge under the rule.
R2-O3, R2-O4: carried — unchanged.
